meta.source: Reserve Bank of India (via the Data Bank)
meta.revisionPolicy: Policy rates and auction results are final when announced. The Handbook restates a few effective dates between editions (newest edition wins, differences listed in rates-policy meta). Lending and deposit rates: each monthly release repeats the full history; the newest release wins.
meta.coverage: The government bond yield curve at every month-end since April 1996: yields for 1 to 30 years to maturity, and the 10-year minus 1-year spread
meta.note: RBI, Month-end Yield of SGL Transactions in Government Dated Securities for Various Maturities (DBIE report 1368; Handbook report 217): yields of central government securities traded in the RBI's SGL, read at whole-year residual maturities. Dated on the first of the month for the month-end it describes.
